names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 iulie, «Sfânta Muceniță Suniva din Norvegia», with the rank words left off.

death.note: The upper bound her own life.md carries: "Her relics were discovered when the Christian king Olaf dug in the cave in the year 996, and in that same year he declared the island of Selja the first holy place in Norway." "The page gives no year for her death", so the bound is open below.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 iulie — «Sfânta Muceniță Suniva din Norvegia»

attestations.note: Her own page gives the reason for the day: «Prăznuirea Sfintei Suniva se face în data de 8 iulie, ziua descoperirii sfintelor sale moaște.»
